title: Hatsune Miku — Original Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's the event you've all been waiting for, the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone in the venue, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about everyone watching online or in live screenings?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Ready!>
<I'm so excited!>
<Miku!!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems like everyone can hear me okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
We can hear you too!
Let's hurry up and get started♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: C'mon now, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like my friends waiting in the wings can't wait any longer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's get the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show started♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How is the show so far, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's some loud cheering!
I thought you were gonna blow me away there!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone watching the stream seems excited too.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Best show ever!>
<This set list is unreal!>
<Literally crying, they sang the song I wanted to hear...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad everyone's having fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But now I think it's time to pause and talk for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna chat for a while while they get ready for the next song!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
Miku, you brought a topic for us to discuss, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Um...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, did you forget to come up with something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, nothing like that.
It's just that I was stuck on which topic to pick right up until the show started.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. But, did you decide in the end?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, my name means “the first sound from the future”...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Using that as a springboard, I'd like our theme to be, “What will our shows be like ten years from now?”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Our shows ten years from now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's an interesting topic that's sure to have us flexing our imagination muscles.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll start us off. I hope that we'll be able to go down into the aisles and walk about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That way we'll be able to interact more intimately with our audience.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That sounds like it would have a lot to offer in terms of immersion and entertainment value.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of immersion, I think it would be lovely if those joining by livestream were able to get more of a sense of the atmosphere in the venue.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Like when the vibe gets really intense, or the audience cheers so loud you get goosebumps! And our singing, of course!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think it will be possible when VR improves. For example, they could have the stage appear as a 3D object right in front of the viewer's eyes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That would give them fuller immersion while they listen to us sing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I love that! Oh, and I hope we'll be able to see everyone's faces more clearly!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone is already happy just for us to read out comments, but we want to be able to see their smiles with our own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku. It looks like we're all set for the next song!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well then, let's put a pin in our little chat!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's plenty left for today's show, everyone! I hope you'll keep up the energy with us until the end!
